composite.alignment_note: 4 fiscal-year period(s) with identical start and end dates for every member (2022-03-31 to 2026-03-31), n=3 peers in every period. Member return sources: StepStone Private Markets: filed fiscal-year returns; Ares Private Markets Fund: filed fiscal-year returns; AMG Pantheon Fund, LLC: filed fiscal-year returns. Excluded from the composite: KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC reports calendar years. Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund and the aligned peers report fiscal years to month 03, so it is excluded from the composite and stays in the side-by-side table. 1 of 4 peers excluded

slot_g.heterogeneity_note: Members span 2 wrapper types (non-traded LLC ('34 Act), tender-offer fund) and 2 leverage regimes (1940-Act asset-coverage limits, no 1940-Act leverage limits (34-Act conglomerate)). Fee bases, leverage and exit rights are not like-for-like, so the comparison is a history of similar investments, not a like-for-like index.
slot_g.label: Peer comparison (paragraphs (g) and (h))
slot_g.survivorship_note: The cohort is the roster's 5 surviving, still-filing products. Funds that closed, merged, or stopped filing are not in it, so any composite carries survivorship bias in the fund's favor. Membership rationales and exclusions are in the roster record.
